environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway or internet gateway route. Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 PrivateLink endpoint service. The NLB target group performs TCP health checks only. VPC endpoint interface is provisioned in consumer VPCs with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalServiceConsumer. The ENIs attached to the VPC endpoint interface inherit security group sg-0abc123def456 which permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. No public DNS resolution exists; the service is resolvable only via the vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890-abcdefgh.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com private DNS entry. Consumer applications connect using AWS SDK service discovery with SigV4 request signing enforced by the endpoint policy condition aws:SignatureVersion.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnets, no IGW/NAT route
config.dns: no public hosted zone, private DNS via VPC endpoint only
config.subnet_routing: no route to 0.0.0.0/0, only local VPC and VPC endpoint routes
